problem: The dependency gate reports blocker identifiers but the issue thread does not show which refreshed snapshot produced them, so a blocked item is re-investigated by hand.
outcome: A blocked work item records the snapshot identifier alongside its blocker reason codes, so the owner can see which refreshed GitHub truth produced the decision.
scope: Include the evaluation snapshot identifier in the durable blocker audit record.
out_of_scope: Changing dependency semantics or blocker reason codes.
requirements: The blocker audit record includes the snapshot identifier of the evaluation that produced it.
Repeated evaluation of unchanged state remains idempotent.
acceptance_criteria: A blocked evaluation writes the snapshot identifier with its reason codes.
Re-evaluating unchanged state does not create a duplicate audit record.

adr_disposition.reason: Extends the accepted dependency-aware readiness decision and keeps GitHub authoritative.

owner_decisions: Audit records stay in GitHub; no local evaluation store is introduced.

source.summary: Extension of an existing project; planned against refreshed GitHub state and the accepted ADRs.
